test_session.title: TestSession
test_session.description: A recording of an employee's typing speed and accuracy test session.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the employee who took the test.

timestamp.description: Server timestamp of when the session was recorded.

totalImagesAttempted.description: Total number of typing entries attempted during the session.

correctEntries.description: Total number of typed entries that precisely matched the expectation.

averageTimeMs.description: The average high-precision typing time across all entries in milliseconds.

level.description: Performance speed evaluation level (A, B, C, D).

details.description: Detailed breakdowns for each individual image typed during the session.

sandbox_user.title: SandboxUser
sandbox_user.description: Custom trainee or administrator operator account profile.

username.description: Unique identifier / username of the operator.

role.description: Assigned access role in the workstation.

custom_invoice.title: CustomInvoice
custom_invoice.description: An invoice document uploaded by an administrator for sandbox trainees to practice typing codes.

id.description: Unique record key of the invoice.

expectedNumber.description: The target expected tax code/registration number to match in typing assessment.

totalAmount.description: Print value text for total billing amount.

customImageUrl.description: Base64 data URI of the uploaded invoice document image.

login_history.title: LoginHistory
login_history.description: An operator authentication event log entry.

username.description: The operator identifier supplied for login.

role.description: Role of the user at the login event moment.

success.description: True if credentials were verified successfully.

timestamp.description: Server timestamp of the sign-in event.

userAgent.description: Browser identity agent of the log initiator workstation.

/test_sessions/{sessionId}.description: Speed and accuracy test records stored per session.

/custom_invoices/{invoiceId}.description: Global custom invoices shared with sandbox practitioners.

/login_history/{logId}.description: Secure sign-in monitoring registries tracked across sessions.
